_meta.description: Seller-owned commercial variation taxonomy. Amazon remains authoritative for parent/child identity; this file describes what each sellable child means for analysis. Production may override this file through PRODUCT_VARIATIONS_PATH so local taxonomy is never overwritten by Git.

fields.family_name: Optional commercial family label shared by siblings
fields.attributes: Arbitrary variation dimensions such as design, ruling, size, color, pack_count, etc. Values are aggregated independently and in combinations by the analytics layer.
